about_the_game:
The Place

2D adventure with elements of action and horror. Walking, dialogues, item searching, solving puzzles, completing tasks. Inventory, shooting, character upgrades.

WHAT IS THE GAME ABOUT?

Plot: Humanity stands on the brink of destruction: Earth has been captured by aliens. Only a bold and decisive step can prevent catastrophe. A secret weapon hidden deep beneath the surface of Venus holds the power to change the course of war. Success of your mission determines the fate of civilization.

You’ll dive into the events of humanity’s greatest space expedition ever, becoming a participant in an international mission to Venus — mankind’s final hope. As a biologist-assistant named Gardener, initially you'll take care of plants aboard the ship. Soon, however, you discover that the true purpose of your mission is far deeper and more complicated.

The team finds itself in complete chaos: communication with Mission Control breaks down, and control over the situation is lost. The only chance lies in penetrating deep into Venus’ underground complexes, exposing conspiracies, and revealing the terrifying truth concealed by the government.

GAME POSSIBILITIES

  • Choose gender and country of origin for your protagonist.

  • Your decisions influence the development of the plot.

  • Upgrade neural connections of your biodroid body and develop new abilities.

WHAT'S INSIDE?

Puzzles: Interesting and diverse challenges await you at every stage.

Graphics: Special artistic atmosphere created by combining numerous images gives the game world unique charm.

Sound: Surrounding environment comes alive with ambient sounds and captivating synthwave music enhancing the feeling of immersion.

Dialogue: Communication with other characters, making important decisions affecting future developments of the storyline.

Mechanics: Zero gravity, flights, vehicle management above ground and underwater. Camera views from side, overhead, and first-person perspectives.

ALSO:

  • Over 12 unique levels.

  • Variety of weapons.

  • Detailed inventory system.

  • Branching missions.

  • Character upgrade opportunities.

Enjoy exploring atmospheric environments and engaging narratives filled with references to famous films and Easter eggs.

Discover the mysteries of Venus, fight for the future of humankind, and reveal the ultimate mystery: Where did we come from and why are we here?

short_description: The Place is an atmospheric science fiction quest inspired by classic works like Aliens, Predator and The X-Files. Immerse yourself in the retro-futuristic aesthetic of the 90s as you travel to Venus to find a weapon against Earth's alien invaders.
